detail: Metadata now matches both buffered RC stages; reconstruction offset remains zero.
Missing BUSY interrupts fail the diagnostic rather than waiting indefinitely.
Timer suppresses later triggers until restart.
Logging is outside measurement windows; IMU FIFO service uses a separate task.
Recorder waits up to 100ms for first interrupt before draining FIFO.
Native model test checks exact byte consumption.
Actual diagnostic boots and initializes IMUs, but SPI2 MISO contention stalls acquisition. Receive-only experiment also failed and was reverted. No passing system trace.
Received board straps, logic levels, reference, supply/noise/timing/SD/Wi-Fi/runtime remain unmeasured.
